text: Vocabulary (Substitution): The police arrested the man who often has his lunch at this afternoon and makes off.
explanation: 'Leaves in haste' captures the meaning of 'makes off' as departing quickly.

text: Vocabulary (Substitution): Zeineb took after her mother; she was as intolerant of liars as her mother was.
explanation: 'Resembled' means to be similar to in appearance or character, matching 'took after' which means to resemble or have characteristics of a family member.

text: Had we met him when he came, we could have convinced him.
options: A. Unfortunately we didn't meet him.
B. We were away when he came.
C. We were able to convince him.
D. I am happy we didn't meet him.
correctAnswer: A. Unfortunately we didn't meet him.
explanation: Option A correctly captures the meaning that they didn't meet him.

text: They kept trying hard to bring him to the position of chairmanship. Unfortunately, however, members chose someone else so much unexpected.
explanation: 'Struggling' is the correct answer as it best describes the difficult effort to get someone into a position, while 'manipulating' implies unethical influence which isn't clearly indicated in the context.

text: Which one of the following is closest in meaning to the word 'plague' in Paragraph 1, Line 3?
explanation: 'Epidemic' is the closest synonym to 'plague' in this context.

text: We wish we ______ her home, but her mom is not in the country. Perhaps we can do that when she gets back next month.
explanation: 'Would send' is correct for expressing a hypothetical wish.

text: Neither staff members nor the police ______ on the premise when the gangs robbed everything. I guess it wouldn't be easy to arrest them.
explanation: 'Were' is correct with 'neither...nor' when the second subject is plural.

text: They had to get together at six in the morning and when we got up at 5:45 a.m., we thought we wouldn't make it. However, we ______ to get there before they left.
explanation: 'Were able' is correct for describing a specific achievement in the past. Unlike 'could,' which typically describes general abilities in the past, 'were able' emphasizes that they succeeded in doing something specific on this occasion.

text: I didn't do it intentionally but I know she got very angry ______ me. I will apologize to her anyway.
explanation: 'At' is the correct preposition after 'angry' in this context.

text: Despite ______ all the questions in this exam correctly, he is not one of my top students. He is just an average.
explanation: 'Answering' is correct as a gerund after 'despite'.

text: His suit is ______ I wouldn't take it even for free.
options: D. not as much costly as
explanation: 'Very different from' fits the context of rejecting something.

text: When I met her at the party, she told me she ______ her salary for the previous month. I just couldn't believe her.
explanation: 'Had collected' is correct for past perfect (before another past action).

text: These are all ______ people. They don't even know what is good and what is not for them. First, give them a thorough explanation and then call me.
explanation: 'Confused' is correct as an adjective describing the people.

text: I would like ______ her before she leaves. There is a big secret she didn't want to tell the family.
explanation: 'To see' is correct after 'would like'.

text: Let me go and check if the car is ready. It ______ when I came this morning.
options: D. will have to be fixed
explanation: 'Was being fixed' is correct for past continuous passive.

text: Put the jumbled words in correct order: next them/ going/ do/ who/ is/ pick/ you/ know/ up/ to?
options: A. Who is next going to pick them up do you know?
B. Do you know who is next going to pick up them?
C. Do you know who is going to pick them up next?
D. You know who is going to do pick them up next?
correctAnswer: C. Do you know who is going to pick them up next?
explanation: Option C forms the grammatically correct sentence.

text: Which one of the following could be an ending to your job application letter?
explanation: 'Yours truly' is the most formal and appropriate closing.

text: Which one of the following could be the right opening to a letter to your close friend?
options: A. Hi, it's been a long time since you wrote.
B. I am writing this letter to express my greetings and...
C. First of all, I would like to apologize for not being able to...
D. I would like to send you this letter hoping that everything is...
correctAnswer: A. Hi, it's been a long time since you wrote.
explanation: Option A is the most natural informal opening.

text: Which one of the following is an appropriate ending to your letter of complaint to a company?
explanation: 'Sincerely' is the most professional closing for a complaint.

text: Which one of the following sentences is most likely taken from an expository piece of writing?
options: A. As soon as I get to the office, I turn my computer on.
B. This kind of computer appears to be better in many ways.
C. Computers are machines used to key in and save information.
D. I have this old but properly functioning computer in my office.
correctAnswer: C. Computers are machines used to key in and save information.
explanation: Option C is factual and explanatory, characteristic of expository writing.

text: Complete the dialogue: Mom: Why don't you buy yourself better shoes, son? Son: ______ I'll buy top-quality ones.
options: A. I like these shoes, Mom
B. These ones are fine, but
C. If Dad gives me more money,
D. All shoes in the town are bad, but
correctAnswer: C. If Dad gives me more money,
explanation: Option C provides the most logical conditional response.

text: Complete the dialogue: Bultum: ______ think of taking a break? Hagos: I was just about to say that. Let's go.
explanation: 'Would you like to' is the most natural way to suggest a break, particularly since Hagos's enthusiastic response indicates it was a direct suggestion rather than just asking for an opinion, which would be implied by the other options.

text: Complete the dialogue: Ziyad: I hear they provide free lunch here. Mukerem: No! ______, nobody will do the public works.
options: B. If there is free lunch
D. If you have free lunch
correctAnswer: B. If there is free lunch
explanation: Option B sets up the conditional statement most logically.

text: Which of the following sentences uses the correct verb tense?
options: A. She has went to the market yesterday.
B. I have seen that movie last week.
C. They had already left when we arrived.
D. We are going to the party last night.
correctAnswer: C. They had already left when we arrived.
explanation: Option C correctly uses past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

text: Select the correct indirect speech: Direct: 'I will help you,' he said.
options: A. He said that he will help me.
B. He said that he would help me.
C. He said that I will help you.
D. He said that he would help you.
correctAnswer: B. He said that he would help me.
explanation: Option B correctly follows the rules for reported speech: the tense shifts from 'will' to 'would', and the pronoun changes from 'I' to 'he' and 'you' to 'me' to reflect the change in speaker perspective.

text: Choose the correct word order:
options: A. She always has been very kind to me.
B. She has been always very kind to me.
C. She has been very kind always to me.
D. She has always been very kind to me.
correctAnswer: D. She has always been very kind to me.
explanation: Option D correctly places the adverb 'always' between the auxiliary 'has' and main verb 'been'.

text: Choose the correct preposition: The book is ______ the table ______ the living room.
explanation: Option C 'on, in' uses the correct prepositions. 'On' is used for placement on a surface (the book is on the table), and 'in' is used for location within an enclosed space (the table is in the living room).

text: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
options: A. The committee approved the new policy.
B. The new policy was approved by the committee.
C. They are considering the new policy.
D. We will implement the policy next month.
correctAnswer: B. The new policy was approved by the committee.
explanation: Option B is passive voice ('was approved') with the doer of the action following 'by'.

text: Which sentence correctly uses a relative clause?
options: A. The man which lives next door is a doctor.
B. The book who I borrowed is very interesting.
C. The city where I was born is quite large.
D. The movie what we saw was exciting.
correctAnswer: C. The city where I was born is quite large.
explanation: Option C correctly uses 'where' as a relative adverb referring to a place.

text: The ______ wilderness was full of wild animals and treacherous paths, making it dangerous for explorers.
explanation: 'Savage' means wild and untamed, which best describes the dangerous wilderness.

text: The city planners hoped that the new park and clean streets would ______ the area, attracting new residents and businesses.
explanation: 'Revitalize' means to give new life or energy to something, which fits the context of improving the area.

text: After the accident, the victim was ______ and could not respond to the doctors' questions.
explanation: The correct answer is 'insensible' as it means unconscious or unable to respond.

text: The detective tried to ______ the meaning of the mysterious message, but it was difficult to understand.
explanation: 'Descry' means to catch sight of or discern something difficult to perceive, which fits the context.

text: The cool morning air and the fresh smell of pine trees were ______, making the hike feel less tiring.
explanation: 'Invigorating' means energizing, which matches the context of making the hike feel less tiring.

text: The feeling of warmth and comfort in her home was ______, something that couldn't be measured but was deeply felt.
explanation: 'Intangible' means unable to be touched or measured, which describes the feeling of warmth and comfort.

text: The museum displayed contemporary art, with works from living artists that reflected modern issues and ideas. (Choose the word that best keeps the meaning of 'contemporary')
explanation: 'Modern' is the best synonym for 'contemporary' in this context.

text: After months of trying to fix the broken car and his inability to be successful, he finally resigned the fact that it would need a new engine. (Choose the word that best keeps the meaning of 'resigned')
explanation: 'Accepted' is the best synonym for 'resigned' in this context.

text: After fasting for 24 hours, he had an intense craving for chocolate cake. (Choose the phrase that best keeps the meaning of 'intense craving')
explanation: 'A strong desire' best captures the meaning of 'intense craving'.

text: As used in paragraph 5, line 4, which word can be the best similar word to 'exacerbating'?
explanation: 'Aggravating' is the best synonym for 'exacerbating' in this context.

text: How does the author develop the mystery surrounding the lost city?
options: A. By presenting multiple theories without a definite conclusion.
B. By stating that researchers have solved the mystery.
C. By describing a detailed battle scene.
D. By focusing only on one possible cause which was highly emphasized.
correctAnswer: A. By presenting multiple theories without a definite conclusion.
explanation: The author presents several theories without concluding which is correct.

text: Next year by this time, he _____ his degree and be starting his new job.
explanation: 'Will have completed' is the correct future perfect tense for an action that will be finished by a specific future time.

text: Letter Writing: Which one of the following sentences in parts of a formal letter could state the reason for writing?
options: A. I am writing to invite you to speak to students during our school charity week.
B. I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience..
C. I hope you will consider my request to talk at our school about raising money for charity.
D. I appreciate the time and effort you have taken to review this letter.
correctAnswer: A. I am writing to invite you to speak to students during our school charity week.
explanation: Option A clearly states the purpose of writing the letter.

text: Sentence comprehension: Choose the sentence which is nearly the same in meaning with 'Had I had money, I would have bought a new house.'
options: A. I was in need of buying a new house that I could afford to get it.
B. I was prohibited from buying a new house because of the insufficient money I have.
C. I was capable of buying a new house regardless of the money I have.
D. Regardless of the money I had I couldn't buy a new house that I was in need of it.
correctAnswer: B. I was prohibited from buying a new house because of the insufficient money I have.
explanation: Option B conveys the same meaning of being unable to buy due to lack of money.

text: Sentence comprehension: Choose the sentence which is nearly the same in meaning with 'Don't forget to buy Robe a present for her birth day.'
options: A. Robe forgot her birthday present.
B. I want you to remember to Robe's address.
C. I want you to remember to buy Robe a gift.
D. Robe must buy you a gift for your birth day.
correctAnswer: C. I want you to remember to buy Robe a gift.
explanation: Option C conveys the same meaning as the original sentence.

text: Which one of the following sentences is written grammatically correct?
options: A. She wore a long, beautiful, blue silk evening dress.
B. She wore a beautiful, blue silk, long, evening dress.
C. She wore a beautiful, long, blue silk evening dress.
D. She wore a blue silk, evening, beautiful, long dress.
correctAnswer: C. She wore a beautiful, long, blue silk evening dress.
explanation: Option C follows the correct order of adjectives: opinion (beautiful), size (long), color (blue), material (silk), purpose (evening).

text: The Djiboutian presidency's spokesman has said that Djibouti's Mahmoud Ali Youssouf ______ Saturday as the chairman of the African Union's executive commission.
explanation: 'Was elected' is the correct passive voice for this context.

text: The meeting ______ place tomorrow afternoon at five o'clock.
explanation: 'Is taking' is the present continuous used for scheduled future events.

text: The book, ______ had been sitting on my shelf for years, turned out to be an incredible read.
explanation: 'Which' is the correct relative pronoun for non-restrictive clauses about things.

text: After Sarah had prepared an elaborate presentation for the meeting, she realized that she ______ her USB drive at home and had to rush back to retrieve it before the meeting started.
explanation: 'Had left' is the past perfect tense needed for an action that occurred before another past action.

text: Which one of the following is not a quality of a good translator?
options: She/he understands the source language well.
She/he is anyone who can speak a second language.
She/he has experience in the subject matter of the text.
She/he is a good writer in the target language.
correctAnswer: She/he is anyone who can speak a second language.
explanation: Being able to speak a second language does not necessarily qualify someone as a good translator. Good translators need specialized skills beyond basic language proficiency, including cultural knowledge, subject expertise, and writing ability.

text: Which one is a component of communicative competence a translator should possess?
explanation: All listed competences are essential for a translator.

text: Complete the dialogue: Qiang: I'm the only child for my family. How about you? Oncho: ______.
explanation: This option follows the correct order of adjectives: number, opinion, size.

text: Which one of the following is the correct order in the process of information exchange in translation?
explanation: The correct order involves the sender, translator, and then the receiver.

text: Wheel chair user: Could you tell me where the computer center is on this building? You: Oh sure, the 3rd room from here. ______. Wheel chair user: Thank you indeed.
options: A. You cannot keep your wheelchair in my office.
B. Can I help you push the wheelchair?
C. Don't leave your wheelchair in my office.
D. Leave your wheelchair in my office.
correctAnswer: B. Can I help you push the wheelchair?
explanation: Option B ('Can I help you push the wheelchair?') is the most polite and helpful response.

text: Complete the sentence: There are two newspapers on my table. ______ of which has an interesting thing to read.
explanation: 'Neither' is used with two items to indicate not one or the other.

text: Main Idea: Transportation plays a critical role in the livability of a community. Access to transportation increases people's ability to access recreation, entertainment, and other activities that promote community engagement. Efficient and affordable transportation ensure that people can obtain services and participate in public life. Participation in public life increases the economic growth of a community
options: A. When people obtain services, their economic growth is ensured.
B. Participation in public life makes transportation affordable.
C. Access to affordable transportation increases a community's participation in public life.
D. Access to recreation ensures the economic growth of a community.
correctAnswer: C. Access to affordable transportation increases a community's participation in public life.
explanation: Option C best summarizes the paragraph's main idea about transportation enabling participation.

text: Comprehension (Reading Passage I): Why is the process of manufacturing recycled paper better for the environment than the process of new paper manufacturing is?
options: A. The by-product of the recycled paper manufacturing process is sludge.
B. The former releases treated wastes.
C. The waste of the recycled paper manufacturing can be added to construction materials.
D. The process does not require as much water as is required in new paper manufacturing.
correctAnswer: D. The process does not require as much water as is required in new paper manufacturing.
explanation: The passage states recycled paper manufacturing uses less water, trees and causes less pollution.

text: Comprehension (Reading Passage I): Which of the following is true according to paragraph 2?
options: A. Particles, wax-coated cellophane and chemicals are the environmental concerns of the paper industry.
B. Cleaner burning fuels, chemicals and the paper produced are the environmental concerns of the paper industry.
C. The paper produced, particles and chemicals are the environmental concerns of the paper industry.
D. Chemicals, corrugated cardboard and the paper produced are the environmental concerns of the paper industry.
correctAnswer: C. The paper produced, particles and chemicals are the environmental concerns of the paper industry.
explanation: Paragraph 2 discusses paper waste, particles and chemicals as main concerns.

text: Final stage in the Research Process is
explanation: Report writing is the final stage of the research process.

text: Recycled paper can be used to make one of the following products. Which one is it? (From Reading Passage I)
explanation: The passage states that recycled paper can be used to make 'food and clothing boxes' among other products.

text: Arrange these sentences to form a coherent paragraph: a. You can use it to talk with your friends or family, for example. b. A mobile phone is a very useful device to get connected with others. c. A mobile phone call can be made in so many ways. d. These days, everyone has a mobile phone.
explanation: The logical order is: b (introduces the topic), d (states prevalence), a (gives an example use), c (provides additional information about usage).

text: Arrange these sentences to form a coherent paragraph: a. The first thing you need is egg. b. Omelet is one of my most favorite food items. c. It is one of the easiest things to do in the kitchen. d. Today, I will show you how to make an omelet.
explanation: The correct order is b (topic introduction), d (purpose statement), c (general comment), a (first step).

text: Arrange these sentences to form a coherent paragraph: a. Schools help us to be consistent, punctual, and obedient. b. In short, we learn how to be better people in schools. c. For example, we learn how to read and write in schools. d. School is the place where we learn new things.
explanation: The correct order is d (general statement), c (specific example), a (additional benefits), b (conclusion).

text: Arrange these sentences to form a coherent paragraph: a. They make their home in buildings, gardens, etc. b. Ants are found everywhere in the world. c. In the summer, ants collect food for the winter season. d. They are very hardworking insects.
explanation: The correct order is b (general statement), d (characteristic), a (habitat), c (specific behavior).

text: Put these words in proper order to make a correct English sentence: with here you return I or until either go wait can me
options: Wait until I can either go or you return with me here.
You can either go with me or wait here until I return.
Until I return you can either go or wait here with me.
With me here you can either wait or go until I return.
correctAnswer: You can either go with me or wait here until I return.
explanation: The correct sentence is: 'You can either go with me or wait here until I return.'

text: Put these words in proper order to make a correct English sentence: to want visit always I have Casablanca
options: I wanted to always have visit Casablanca.
Always I wanted to have visit Casablanca.
I have always wanted to visit Casablanca.
Casablanca I have always wanted to visit.
correctAnswer: I have always wanted to visit Casablanca.
explanation: The correct sentence is: 'I have always wanted to visit Casablanca.'

text: Where would you write a request for an action in the format of a formal letter?
options: in the Body of the letter
correctAnswer: in the Body of the letter
explanation: Requests for action are made in the Body of a formal letter.

text: What is the primary function of a topic sentence?
options: To introduce the main idea of the paragraph
correctAnswer: To introduce the main idea of the paragraph
explanation: A topic sentence introduces the main idea of a paragraph.

text: What is the primary focus of a plot analysis?
options: The themes present in the text
The structure and events of the story
correctAnswer: The structure and events of the story
explanation: Plot analysis focuses on examining the structure, sequence, and development of events in a narrative. It typically involves analyzing elements like exposition, rising action, conflict, climax, falling action, and resolution. While characters, themes, and settings are integral to the story, plot analysis specifically examines how events unfold and connect to create the narrative's overall structure.

text: Unless viable solutions are sought for our development problems, the people will keep suffering under poverty. So, let us get together and find the way out.
explanation: 'Sustainable' is the correct answer as it means able to be maintained at a certain rate or level.

text: Which of the statements below is true about cleaner-burning fuels? (From Reading Passage I about paper manufacturing)
options: They make many paper packaging unrecyclable
They affect the growth of trees and plants
They reduce the amount of sulfur dioxide produced.
correctAnswer: They reduce the amount of sulfur dioxide produced.
explanation: According to the passage, 'Many paper companies have reduced the amount of sulfur dioxide emitted during production by switching to cleaner-burning fuels.'

text: It appears the combined effort exerted by the team significantly contributed to their success. In fact, we need to take a lesson and reshape our strategy.
explanation: 'Synergy' is the correct answer as it means the interaction of elements that produce a combined effect greater than the sum of their separate effects.

text: Which of the following can be the best title for the passage? (From Reading Passage I)
explanation: The passage primarily focuses on paper recycling and its benefits.

text: Which of the following is an example of non-recyclable material? (From Reading Passage I)
explanation: The passage states 'While newspapers are recyclable, their glossy, colored inserts are not,' identifying glossy, colored inserts as non-recyclable.

text: Why is paper considered as an environmental problem by paper manufacturers themselves? (From Reading Passage I)
options: Much of the paper produced, if not recycled, is dumped into landfill.
Many paper companies release untreated wastes.
Much of the paper produced cannot be recycled.
Much of the paper produced is dumped into landfills.
correctAnswer: Much of the paper produced, if not recycled, is dumped into landfill.
explanation: The passage emphasizes landfill issues from unrecycled paper.

text: Which word used in paragraph 2 refers to a site for sanitary waste disposal? (From Reading Passage I)
explanation: 'Landfill' refers to a site for waste disposal.

text: What does 'them' as used in 'This makes them non-recyclable...' (Paragraph 2) refer to? (From Reading Passage I)
explanation: 'Them' refers back to 'many kinds of paper packaging' mentioned earlier.

text: As used in paragraph 1, which word from those given below is similar in meaning to gorge? (From Reading Passage II about vegetarianism)
explanation: To 'gorge' means to eat greedily or stuff oneself with food.

text: Which of the following can be the best title for the passage? (From Reading Passage II)
explanation: The passage covers various aspects of vegetarianism broadly.

text: Which statement is true according to paragraph 4? (From Reading Passage II)
options: Followers of the Ethiopian Coptic church abhor the taking of life on more than 200 days.
Enforced vegetarianism is common among eighteen percent of the world's population.
In Africa and Asia, the cost of meat is seldom beyond what the poor can afford to buy.
Vegetarianism has become a matter of individual choice in Africa and Asia
correctAnswer: Enforced vegetarianism is common among eighteen percent of the world's population.
explanation: Paragraph 4 states 'About eighteen per cent of the world's populations (excluding China) eat less than 10g (0.3oz) of animal protein per head per day' due to economic necessity, which is a form of enforced vegetarianism.

text: Which of the following is the consequence of the spread of wealth in Europe and the West? (From Reading Passage II)
options: an increase in the amount of animal protein eaten
a decrease in the amount of animal protein produced
an increase in the mount of vegetable eaten
correctAnswer: an increase in the amount of animal protein eaten
explanation: The passage states affluence leads to more animal protein consumption.

text: Of the words given below, which one from paragraph 3 can be replaced by dislike? (From Reading Passage II)
explanation: 'Abhor' means to regard with disgust and hatred, stronger than but similar to 'dislike'.

text: Which one of the following is a reason why vegetarianism eventually gained public acceptance? (From Reading Passage II)
options: increase in our understanding of the appetizing nature of meat.
decline in the spread of a concentrated form of nutrient.
increase in our awareness of the benefits of vegetarianism.
decline in the flavors and smell of meat.
correctAnswer: increase in our awareness of the benefits of vegetarianism.
explanation: The passage suggests growing awareness contributed to vegetarianism's acceptance.

text: Choose from those given below an example of the evolutionary argument referred to in paragraph 2. (From Reading Passage II)
explanation: The passage mentions human teeth evolved for tubers/seed, not meat.

text: Disheartening as used in paragraph 2 can be replaced with which one of the following words? (From Reading Passage II)
explanation: 'Disheartening' means causing someone to lose determination or confidence; depressing.

text: What can we deduce from Paragraph 2 about the mission of the University of Michigan's Animal Diversity Web (ADW)?
options: A. It specializes in chimps and has comprehensive information on them.
B. It is among the top institutions in the world that studies the apes family.
C. It offers courses on various animals found in different parts of the world.
D. It provides information on different animal species to foster comparisons.
correctAnswer: D. It provides information on different animal species to foster comparisons.
explanation: Option D is correct because the passage cites ADW as a source of comparative information about chimpanzees (their weight, size, etc.), suggesting its mission is to provide detailed information about different animal species for comparison and reference purposes.

text: Which sentence is closest to the head sentence: In the West or in Europe, there is a great variety of food for people to buy if they want to.
options: There is no need for a great variety of food in the West or in Europe.
People in the West or in Europe buy a great variety of food.
There is no food shortage in the West or in Europe.
People in the West or in Europe want a great variety of food.
correctAnswer: People in the West or in Europe buy a great variety of food.
explanation: This option best captures the availability and consumption of varied foods.

text: Substitute the underlined phrase: Seventy is a compulsory retirement age in some developed countries. Do you mean they are ______ to retire at the age of 70?
explanation: 'Forced' conveys the mandatory nature similar to 'compulsory'.

text: Substitute the underlined phrase: The police arrested the man who often has his lunch at this afternoon and makes off.
explanation: 'Makes off' means to leave quickly, especially to escape.

text: Substitute the underlined word: The use of real life situations made the activity so interactive that everyone in the class loved it.
explanation: 'Participatory' best captures the meaning of 'interactive' in this context.

text: Substitute the underlined word: There is no point in complaining about his immature behavior; he is always nagging his girlfriend over trivial points.
explanation: 'Childlike' suggests behavior typical of someone younger, similar to 'immature'.

text: Substitute the underlined phrase: Zeineb took after her mother; she was as intolerant of liars as her mother was.
explanation: 'Took after' means resembled in characteristics or behavior.

text: We all failed in the recruitment exam. ______, they accepted none of us. I think another round of advertisement is inevitable.
explanation: 'Consequently' is correct to show result.

text: Complete the question: ______ does it take students to do their bachelor's degree in Physics?
explanation: 'How long' asks about duration of time.

text: The nightmarish storm caused widespread panic, with dark clouds, terrifying winds, and an eerie stillness before it hit. (Choose the phrase that best keeps the meaning of 'nightmarish')
explanation: 'Terrifying and surreal' best describes the nightmarish quality of the storm.

text: The movie was filled with horrifying scenes of destruction, leaving the audience gasping in shock and disbelief. (Choose the word that best keeps the meaning of 'horrifying')
explanation: 'Alarming' best captures the shocking and frightening nature of the scenes.

text: Complete the sentence: ______ my grade was satisfactory, I feel I studied hard this semester.
explanation: 'Although' properly introduces a contrasting clause.

text: Complete the sentence: If you continue practising speaking English like this, you ______ speak it fluently very soon.
explanation: 'Will be able to' expresses future capability resulting from current practice.

text: Complete the sentence: ______, this noise will die down soon; surely, it has been a terribly noisy night.
explanation: 'Hopefully' expresses the speaker's wish about the noise subsiding.

text: Complete the sentence: I cannot afford to go out this weekend; I have ______ assignments on my table.
explanation: 'Too many' explains why the speaker can't go out (overwhelmed with work).

text: Complete the sentence: The witness was ______ biased that whatever he said was unbelievable.
explanation: 'So' is used with 'that' to show degree of quality (biased).

text: Complete the sentence: She doesn't speak French very well, ______?
explanation: The correct question tag for a negative statement with 'doesn't' is 'does she'.

text: Complete the sentence: I have read ______ I did last year; it has been a terribly busy year for me.
explanation: 'Fewer...than' is the correct comparative form for countable nouns (books).

text: Complete the sentence: She has just had a haircut; she ______ 20 in this new hair style, doesn't she?
explanation: 'Looks like' is the most natural way to express appearance similarity.

text: Sports Journalist: Do you have an athlete to admire? You: Yes.
options: A. Darartu Tulu is a courageous athlete you should admire.
B. I admire Darartu Tulu; she is such a well-behaved model athlete of all time.
C. Don't you admire Darartu Tulu yourself?
D. Athletes work in competitive situations. Admire them.
correctAnswer: B. I admire Darartu Tulu; she is such a well-behaved model athlete of all time.
explanation: Option B ('I admire Darartu Tulu...') is the most complete and appropriate response to the question.

text: Complete the sentence: My grade this semester is ______ than my first semester's.
explanation: 'Much better' is the correct comparative form.

text: Complete the sentence: I have no time to spare! I will ______ myself a sandwich and get back to work quickly.
explanation: 'Make' is the most common verb used with sandwiches.

text: Complete the sentence: I don't have a car. ______, I don't even have a driving license.
explanation: 'Furthermore' adds additional related information to the initial statement.

text: What does the passage suggest about the role of the environment in the city's collapse?
options: A. The city was built on unstable ground.
B. Climate change and deforestation may have led to food shortages.
C. There was a volcanic eruption that buried the city.
D. The environment played no role in its disappearance but pandemics.
correctAnswer: B. Climate change and deforestation may have led to food shortages.
explanation: The passage mentions environmental changes as one possible cause of collapse.

text: Word Order: At top voice the man his of demanded the admission shouting
options: A. At the top voice, the man demanding shouting his admission of.
B. The man demanding, shouting his admission of at the top voice.
C. Shouting at the top of his voice, the man demanded admission.
D. Shouting his voice, at the top the man demanded admission of.
correctAnswer: C. Shouting at the top of his voice, the man demanded admission.
explanation: Option C is the only grammatically correct sentence with proper word order.

text: Complete the sentence: Look, ______ books, newspapers, shoes and socks scattered everywhere on the floor; why don't you keep your room tidy?
explanation: 'There are' is the correct existential construction for listing items present.

text: Complete the sentence: I'm worried about my driving test; I think I ______ hear bad news again.
explanation: 'Am going to' expresses a prediction based on current evidence or feeling.

text: _________________ helps to reveal the underlying structure and logic of how words convey meaning within a language system.
options: The truth conditional theory of meaning
explanation: The componential theory of meaning analyzes the semantic features that make up the meaning of words, revealing the underlying structure and organization of meaning within a language system.

text: Which one of the following best describes derivational morphemes?
options: Derivation morphemes create new words, but they may or may not change the word category of words to which they are added.
Derivational morphemes signal only grammatical information about words to which they are suffixed.
Derivational morphemes do not change the meaning and word category of words to which they are attached.
Derivational morphemes change the meaning of words to which they are affixed, but they may or may not create new words.
correctAnswer: Derivation morphemes create new words, but they may or may not change the word category of words to which they are added.
explanation: Derivational morphemes can create new words (e.g., 'happy' to 'unhappy') and may change the word category (e.g., 'teach' [verb] to 'teacher' [noun]), but this category change doesn't always occur (e.g., 'happy' to 'unhappy' - both are adjectives).

text: The contextual theory of meaning states that translators must be sensitive to
explanation: The contextual theory of meaning emphasizes that words derive their meaning from context rather than in isolation. Translators must consider cultural contexts (social norms), situational contexts (circumstances), and linguistic contexts (surrounding text) to accurately convey meaning across languages.

text: What are the core elements of a Research Process?
options: Introduction; Data Collection; Data Analysis; Conclusions and Recommendations
Executive Summary; Literature Review; Data Gathered; Conclusions; Bibliography
Research Plan; Research Data; Analysis; References
Introduction; Literature Review; Research Methodology; Results; Discussions and Conclusion
correctAnswer: Introduction; Literature Review; Research Methodology; Results; Discussions and Conclusion
explanation: The standard core elements of a research process include: Introduction (problem statement), Literature Review (examining existing research), Research Methodology (approach and methods), Results (findings), and Discussion/Conclusion (interpretation and implications).

text: There lived a king and a prince in a big palace. This is most likely an introduction to _____ writing
explanation: The phrase 'There lived a king and a prince in a big palace' is a classic opening for a narrative writing, specifically reminiscent of fairy tales or stories. It introduces characters and a setting, signaling the beginning of a story rather than an explanation, description, or argument.

text: What is the English equivalent to the Amharic proverb 'ድር ቢያብር አንበሳ ያስር'?
options: Don't count your chickens before they hatch
explanation: The Amharic proverb 'ድር ቢያብር አንበሳ ያስር' literally translates to 'When spider webs unite, they can tie up a lion,' which emphasizes the power of collaboration. The closest English equivalent is 'Unity is strength' or 'In unity there is strength,' not 'Actions speak louder than words.'

text: A specific plan or protocol for conducting research that allows the researcher to transform conceptual hypothesis into practical one is________.
explanation: Study design refers to the specific methodology and protocol that researchers use to test hypotheses and answer research questions. It provides the structure for translating conceptual ideas into practical, testable procedures, including data collection methods, variables to measure, and analysis techniques.

text: The design feature or property of language that enables human beings to talk about the past, the present, the future, the hypothetical and things that do not exist is
explanation: Displacement is the language property that allows humans to communicate about things not present in the immediate environment, including past events, future possibilities, hypothetical scenarios, and abstract concepts. This distinguishes human language from most animal communication systems, which are typically limited to the here and now.

text: (1)In the crowded areas of high pollution such as Los Angeles, it is estimated that people are losing about 10 years, on the average, of their life spans. (2)Diseases related to air pollution, such as emphysema, are more and more common in younger and younger people. (3) The people who live in Los Angeles are friendly and cheerful as well. (4)Continued rapid growth of the human population will lead to more pollution and a lower standard of health for everyone. (5)More polluting cars will be needed for transport; (6) more polluting factories will be needed to produce goods. (7)More fertilizer and pesticide pollution will occur as people attempt to grow more and more food.( 8) Generally, polluted environment can shorten human life expectancy. (Ehrlich P. 474) What is the central idea of the above paragraph?
options: People who live in highly crowded and polluted area are losing about 10 years, on the average, of their life span
Emphysema, among many of the diseases, is more and more common in younger people
Continued rapid growth of human population will lead to more pollution
More polluting cars will be needed for transport and more polluting factories will be used to produce goods.
correctAnswer: People who live in highly crowded and polluted area are losing about 10 years, on the average, of their life span
explanation: The central idea focuses on the loss of life expectancy due to pollution.

text: Which of the following is a common theme in literature?
explanation: All listed options are common themes found in literature.

text: Paragraph Development Techniques: '... One day a strange thing happened in my village. It was summer and for some reason I had been hot and irritable all morning. ...'This piece of writing is most likely taken from______.
explanation: The passage tells a story with a first-person perspective, characteristic of narrative writing.

text: Why is the process of manufacturing recycled paper better for the environment than the process of new paper manufacturing is? (From Reading Passage I)
options: The waste of the recycled paper manufacturing can be added to construction materials.
The process does not require as much water as is required in new paper manufacturing.
The by-product of the recycled paper manufacturing process is sludge.
correctAnswer: The process does not require as much water as is required in new paper manufacturing.
explanation: The passage states recycled paper manufacturing uses less water than new paper manufacturing.

text: What is the Amharic equivalent to the English proverb 'Actions speak louder than words'?
options: ተግባር ከቃላት የበለጠ ጮክ ብሎ ይናገራል፡፡
ተግባር ከቃላት የበለጠ የሰዉን ማንነት ይገልጻል፡፡
correctAnswer: ተግባር ከቃላት የበለጠ ጮክ ብሎ ይናገራል፡፡
explanation: The first option is the correct Amharic equivalent of the proverb.

text: In a story, the narrator is both the narrator and the central character of the story is ______________
explanation: This describes a first-person point of view where the narrator is also a character.

text: Which sentence is the CONCLUDING SENTENCE in the paragraph?
options: For the reasons, every year millions of people pack up and move to new places.
Others are attracted to places with better weather.
Still others want to move to a place with less crime.
Finally people often want to move to a place with a lower cost of living.
correctAnswer: For the reasons, every year millions of people pack up and move to new places.
explanation: The concluding sentence summarizes the reasons for moving. 'For the reasons, every year millions of people pack up and move to new places' functions as a conclusion by referring back to the previously mentioned reasons and stating their result.

text: What types of paragraph is it?
explanation: The paragraph describes reasons for moving, which is expository in nature, not narrative. Expository paragraphs explain, inform, or describe a topic with facts and details.

text: __________ is the creation of characters that can effectively dramatize a story.
explanation: Characterization is the process of creating characters in a story.

text: The way of presenting literary work that the narrator knows everything that needs to be known about the agents and events with free movement within time and place, character to character. This is ____
explanation: This describes a third-person omniscient point of view.

text: _______________ fulfill the two main aims of translation, i.e. accuracy and economy.
explanation: Semantic and communicative translations aim for accuracy and economy.

text: What is the PREDICATE of the sentence 'Some people live to eat.'?
explanation: The predicate describes what the subject does.

text: The little boy visits this clean restaurant every weekend. What is the SUBJECT of this sentence?
explanation: The subject of the sentence is 'The little boy.'

text: ________ refers to the regular occurrence of the accent or stress in a poem.
explanation: Meter refers to the rhythmic structure of a poem.

text: ‘Obse likes walking, dancing, swimming and she likes reading.’ What is the name of error in the above sentence?
explanation: The sentence exhibits faulty parallelism in the list of activities.

text: Before considering a speech topic, what are the questions you do NOT ask yourself as the presenter?
options: Am I an expert on this topic?
Will I read the topic well?
Does my audience care about this topic?
Am I passionate about this topic?
correctAnswer: Will I read the topic well?
explanation: The second option is not a question to consider before choosing a topic.

text: In _______________ translation, both content and language are easily acceptable and comprehensible to the readers.
explanation: Communicative translation aims for clarity and comprehension.

text: African literature is a body of literature that consists of _________
explanation: African literature encompasses various languages, cultures, and historical contexts.

text: ‘Do yours only!’ What is the SUBJECT of this sentence?
explanation: The subject of the imperative sentence is 'You', implied.

text: The interpretative strategy that the meaning of a story is constructed by the interaction of the text and the reader's experience. This most probably can be termed as______ _______
explanation: Reader-based interpretation focuses on the interaction between the text and the reader.

text: In Gustav's plot structure, the laying out of the materials in the story such as the main characters, their backgrounds, interests, goals, and limitations are dealt in____________
explanation: Exposition introduces the characters and their backgrounds.

text: _____________ is used to improve communication or to compensate for communication breakdowns.
explanation: Strategic competence helps in managing communication effectively.

text: The translator's task is in contrast with that of the monolingual communicator because
options: It consists of re-encoding into a different language
It concerns the same message as was received
It is aimed at a group of receivers who are not the same as the original sender
All of the above are correct
correctAnswer: All of the above are correct
explanation: All options describe the unique challenges faced by translators.

text: ‘Please explain to me how you studied for this exit exam.’ What is the functional classification of this sentence?
explanation: The sentence is an imperative as it requests an explanation.

text: Which sentence above is the TOPIC SENTENCE?
options: Some moved to find better jobs or to advance their careers.
Others are attracted to places with better weather.
There are so many reasons why people move.
Finally people often want to move to a place with a lower cost of living.
correctAnswer: There are so many reasons why people move.
explanation: The topic sentence introduces the main idea of the paragraph.

text: ______________ uses exaggerated statements for emphasis or effect.
explanation: Hyperbole is a figure of speech that involves exaggeration.

text: The characteristics of written literature is _____
options: Transmitted through the words of mouth
Realized in the process of reading
correctAnswer: Realized in the process of reading
explanation: Written literature is realized through the reading process.

text: ___________________ is an imperative tool for gaining audience curiosity and it implies how high or low your voice is presented.
explanation: Pitch refers to the highness or lowness of the voice.

text: ________ is a literature that handed through the words of mouth from generation to generation.
explanation: Oral literature is passed down through generations orally.

text: All are the general purpose of the speech EXCEPT
explanation: None of the options listed are excluded as general purposes of speech.

text: 'The little boy visits this clean restaurant every weekend.' What is the SUBJECT of this sentence?
explanation: The subject of the sentence is 'The little boy.'

text: Sources of Literature review are all, except?
explanation: Discussions are not typically considered formal sources for a literature review, which should rely on published, peer-reviewed materials like books, journals, and articles. Informal discussions lack the scholarly rigor and verification required for literature reviews.

text: Who defines literature as 'what the reader and writer agree to consider as literature'?
explanation: The Reader-Response Theory, developed by theorists like Stanley Fish and Wolfgang Iser, emphasizes that literature is defined through the interaction between the reader and the text, suggesting that what constitutes literature is a mutual agreement between writers and readers.

text: _________ refers to a poem which describes rural life or tranquil happiness.
explanation: An idyll (or idyl) is a type of poem that depicts peaceful, idealized rural scenes or simple, tranquil aspects of country life. The word derives from the Greek 'eidyllion,' meaning 'little picture.'

text: According to Alexander Pope, what does the word criticism mean?
options: Determining the worthiness of a work rather than its meaning
It's a mere evaluation of a work
Understanding the rules for good poetry and vice versa
explanation: Alexander Pope, particularly in his 'Essay on Criticism,' viewed criticism as both determining the value or merit of a literary work and understanding the principles that govern good literature. He believed criticism should be guided by nature and reason.

text: Published information in a particular subject area is discussed in
explanation: A literature review specifically discusses and synthesizes published information in a particular subject area, providing an overview of existing research, identifying patterns, gaps, and relationships in the literature.

text: What is/are the main functions of the editorial department?
options: Editorials and selection of lead articles
explanation: The editorial department in media organizations performs multiple functions including analyzing news, writing editorials, selecting lead articles, and dramatizing events to provide context and perspective. These collectively help shape the publication's voice and viewpoint.

text: Which one of the following is the correct order between the participants of the communication process in translation?
explanation: In the translation communication process, the sender (author) creates the original message, the translator interprets and transfers this message to another language, and finally the receiver (reader/audience) receives the translated message.

text: Ali: Excuse me, is this the best way to Madda Walabu University? Hana: ___________
explanation: The grammatically and logically correct response to Ali's question asking if this is the best way to the university is 'No, it is not.' The other options contain contradictions or improper grammar.

text: If a piece of writing ends by saying 'The scene was colorful and attractive and we enjoyed it' It is likely from a writing that is
explanation: This ending focuses on sensory details (colorful, attractive) and personal experience (we enjoyed it), which are hallmarks of descriptive writing. Descriptive writing aims to create vivid images and sensory impressions rather than explain, argue, or persuade.

text: All of the following are the types of research on the basis of objective EXCEPT:
explanation: When classifying research by objective, the main types are exploratory (investigating new areas), descriptive (describing phenomena), and explanatory (explaining relationships). Correlation research falls under explanatory research. Applied research is classified by purpose (practical application) rather than by objective.

text: During speech, the proper use of sounds to form words clearly and accurately is
explanation: Pronunciation refers to the way in which a word or language is spoken, particularly the clear and accurate articulation of sounds to form recognizable words. The other options relate to literary devices or voice qualities, not to the proper formation of words.

text: Most of us edit as we write and write as we edit, what types of editing is it?
explanation: The ongoing edit refers to the continuous process where writing and editing happen simultaneously rather than as separate stages. This recursive process involves making changes and improvements while the text is still being created.

text: What are the three general purposes for giving speech?
options: To persuade, act, & adjust your speaking style
To inform, make people laugh, & have fun
explanation: In public speaking and communication theory, the three general purposes of speeches are to inform (provide knowledge), to persuade/convince (influence beliefs or actions), and to entertain (amuse or please the audience).

text: (1)In the crowded areas of high pollution such as Los Angeles, it is estimated that people are losing about 10 years, on the average, of their life spans. (2)Diseases related to air pollution, such as emphysema, are more and more common in younger and younger people. (3) The people who live in Los Angeles are friendly and cheerful as well. (4)Continued rapid growth of the human population will lead to more pollution and a lower standard of health for everyone. (5)More polluting cars will be needed for transport; (6) more polluting factories will be needed to produce goods. (7)More fertilizer and pesticide pollution will occur as people attempt to grow more and more food.( 8) Generally, polluted environment can shorten human life expectancy. (Ehrlich P. 474) Which sentence deviates from the controlling idea of the above paragraph?
explanation: Sentence 3 about Los Angeles residents being 'friendly and cheerful' deviates from the paragraph's controlling idea, which focuses on the negative health impacts of pollution and population growth. All other sentences consistently address pollution and its consequences on health and lifespan.

text: In the profession of proofreading one is not basic abilities required?
explanation: While sharp eyesight, rich vocabulary, and education are directly relevant to proofreading skills, having good relationships is not a basic ability required specifically for proofreading tasks, which focus on detecting and correcting errors in written materials.

text: ____________ the early 19th century novelist and feminist writer who produced novels like sense and sensibility, pride and prejudice etc.
explanation: Jane Austen (1775-1817) was the renowned early 19th century novelist who wrote 'Sense and Sensibility' (1811) and 'Pride and Prejudice' (1813), among other works. Her novels often featured intelligent female protagonists and social commentary, contributing to her recognition as an early feminist writer.

text: From the following sentences one is an example of personification
explanation: Personification attributes human characteristics to non-human entities. 'The flowers are nodded' gives flowers the human action of nodding. 'The world is a stage' is a metaphor comparing the world to a stage, not personification. 'As blind as a bat' is a simile, and 'Everybody knows that' contains no figurative language.

text: Which of the following is characteristic of poor Literature?
explanation: Poor literature is characterized by being narrow and shallow in scope and depth. It lacks comprehensive analysis and insight. In contrast, good literature typically demonstrates critical evaluation, clarity, and conciseness, which are qualities that enhance rather than diminish literary value.

text: ____________syllable is pronounced louder than the other.
explanation: A stressed syllable is pronounced with greater emphasis, loudness, pitch, or length compared to other syllables in a word. This feature is important in English pronunciation and affects both meaning and rhythm in speech.

text: __________research is concerned with discovering and testing certain variables with respect to their association or disassociation
explanation: Diagnostic research focuses on identifying the causes or nature of a specific phenomenon by examining the relationships between variables. It tests hypotheses about associations or disassociations between factors to understand underlying mechanisms or causes.

text: Which one of the following are not the features of epic poem?
options: The hero is a great national hero.
It is the expression of grief on the occasion of a particular person's death.
correctAnswer: It is the expression of grief on the occasion of a particular person's death.
explanation: An epic poem typically features a national hero, grand settings, and superhuman deeds or divine intervention. The expression of grief for a particular person's death describes an elegy, not an epic poem. Epics are narrative poems celebrating heroic deeds and significant events.

text: What is the Amharic equivalent to the English proverb 'You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make him drink it.'?
options: የነ ቶሎ ቶሎ ቤት ግድግዳው ሰንበሌጥ ::
explanation: The Amharic proverb 'ፈረስ ያደርሳል እንጂ አይዋጋም፡፡' translates approximately to 'A horse can take you there but won't fight for you.' This conveys a similar meaning to the English proverb 'You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make him drink' - both express the idea that you can provide opportunity but cannot force someone to take advantage of it.

text: Which one of the following is INCORRECT about human language?
options: There are no primitive languages; all languages are equal in their complexity.
Language is species specific, that is, only human beings have the capacity to learn and use language.
Language is genetically transferred from parents to offspring.
Human beings are born with the capacity to acquire language.
correctAnswer: Language is genetically transferred from parents to offspring.
explanation: Language is not genetically transferred from parents to offspring; it is acquired through exposure and social interaction. While humans have an innate capacity for language acquisition, the specific language learned depends on environment, not genetic inheritance. The other statements are correct principles in linguistics.

text: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a short story?
options: It has a limited number of characters
It focuses on a single incident
It is longer than a novel
It has a clear plot structure
correctAnswer: It is longer than a novel
explanation: Short stories are typically shorter than novels.

text: Why do you need to review the existing literature?
options: To make sure you have a long list of references
Because without it, you could never reach the required word-count
To find out what is already known about your area of interest
To help in your general studying
correctAnswer: To find out what is already known about your area of interest
explanation: Reviewing literature helps identify existing knowledge in your research area.

text: What do we mean when we say that a critic must have 'imaginative sympathy'?
options: A critic must put himself in place of the writer
A critic must see through own point of view
A critic must share reader's vision of life.
correctAnswer: A critic must put himself in place of the writer
explanation: Having 'imaginative sympathy' means a critic must attempt to understand the writer's intent, perspective, and artistic vision rather than imposing only their own viewpoint. This concept, emphasized by critics like Matthew Arnold, suggests that effective criticism requires empathetically entering into the author's creative mindset.

text: _________ is a formal and sustained lament in verse for the death of a particular person.
explanation: An elegy is a poem that mourns the death of an individual.

text: The combination of strong and the weak stress which make up the recurrent metric unit of a line is _____
explanation: A foot is the basic unit of measurement in poetry.

text: Etymologically, from which Greek word is the term 'criticism' derived? It means?
options: 'krinein' which means to judge or discern
'Critic' which means a person who evaluates
correctAnswer: 'krinein' which means to judge or discern
explanation: The term 'criticism' comes from 'krinein', meaning to judge.

text: A variant of a single and the same phoneme is termed as ___________________.
explanation: Allophones are variations of a single phoneme.

text: One of the following is a monosyllabic word.
explanation: The word 'boy' is a monosyllabic word.

text: Method of speech allows you to divide your topic into subtopics that address the components of the topic is __.
explanation: Topical organization divides the subject into subtopics.

text: Which of the following is related to connotative meaning of words?
explanation: Connotative meaning involves the associations and emotions connected to a word.

text: The following titles are used as Italics except?
explanation: Nicknames are not typically italicized.

text: If you read the write-up aloud with slow speed, you have senses
explanation: Reading aloud engages both listening and seeing senses.

text: Pragmatics studies
options: The direct and explicit meaning of words and sentences.
The denotative and conventional meaning of utterances.
The intended meaning of the speaker rather than the direct meaning of words.
The implicit and explicit meaning of utterances.
correctAnswer: The intended meaning of the speaker rather than the direct meaning of words.
explanation: Pragmatics focuses on the intended meaning behind utterances.

text: The purposes of Literature review are all, except?
explanation: Copy pasting is not a legitimate purpose of a literature review.

text: A branch of linguistics that studies language at a specific time and place is
explanation: Synchronic linguistics focuses on language at a specific point in time.

text: The analysis of the component feet, pauses and phrases falling is called______
explanation: Meter refers to the rhythmic structure of verses in poetry.

text: Kebede: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to president office, please? Gifti: ______________________________________
options: Yes! Go straight ahead till you reach the curve, then turn to left.
Yeah! Go down straight for about five minutes, It is on the right hand side.
I'm sorry! I have no any idea about it; you had better ask someone who knows.
explanation: All responses provide directions or acknowledge a lack of knowledge.

text: Which one of the following is/are not true about editing & proofreading?
options: Can be done by one person who has the ability for them.
Proofreading is the final stage of the editing process.
Editing involves reading for content and information.
Editing and proofreading processes should be seen separately.
correctAnswer: Editing and proofreading processes should be seen separately.
explanation: Editing and proofreading are often interconnected processes.

text: What is the primary purpose of a thesis statement?
options: To present the main argument or claim
correctAnswer: To present the main argument or claim
explanation: A thesis statement presents the main argument or claim of the paper.

text: What is the role of a literary critic?
options: To summarize the plot of a work
To evaluate and interpret literary works
correctAnswer: To evaluate and interpret literary works
explanation: Literary critics evaluate and interpret literary works.

text: What is the main purpose of using transitions in writing?
options: To connect ideas and improve flow
correctAnswer: To connect ideas and improve flow
explanation: Transitions help connect ideas and improve the flow of writing.

text: What is the primary focus of stylistics in literary analysis?
options: The historical context of a work
The language and style of the text
correctAnswer: The language and style of the text
explanation: Stylistics focuses on the language and style used in a text.

text: What is the main purpose of a narrative hook?
explanation: A narrative hook is designed to grab the reader's attention from the start.

text: What is the purpose of foreshadowing in literature?
explanation: Foreshadowing hints at events that will occur later in the story.

text: What is the main purpose of a research proposal?
explanation: A research proposal outlines the plan for conducting research before the project begins. It typically includes the research problem, objectives, significance, literature review, methodology, timeline, and resources needed. Unlike a research report, it doesn't contain findings or conclusions since it's prepared before the research is conducted, serving to persuade reviewers or funding agencies of the project's merit.

text: What is the primary focus of a character analysis?
options: The development and traits of a character
correctAnswer: The development and traits of a character
explanation: A character analysis primarily focuses on examining the development, personality traits, motivations, and role of a specific character within a literary work. It explores how the character changes throughout the narrative, their relationships with other characters, their significance to themes, and how literary techniques establish their identity and purpose in the story.

text: What is the main purpose of a summary in writing?
explanation: A summary condenses the main ideas, key points, and essential information of a text into a shorter form while maintaining the original meaning. It presents the core content without detailed analysis, examples, or supporting evidence. Unlike analysis (which examines and evaluates) or introduction (which presents new material), a summary specifically focuses on concisely representing existing content.

text: What is the primary focus of a thematic analysis?
options: The themes present in the text
correctAnswer: The themes present in the text
explanation: Thematic analysis focuses on identifying, examining, and interpreting the themes present in a text. It looks for recurring ideas, patterns of meaning, and underlying messages that express the work's central concerns or insights. While plot, setting, and characters contribute to theme development, thematic analysis specifically concentrates on the abstract concepts and messages conveyed through these elements.

text: Grammar: ______ does it take students to do their bachelor's degree in Physics?
explanation: Option D ('How long') is correct for asking about duration of time.

text: Education is fundamental to development and growth. The human mind makes possible all development achievements. Advances in health, agricultural and public administration are a few examples of development achievements. There is no better tool than education for countries to achieve these development goals. What is the main idea of this paragraph?
options: The human mind is a better tool for advanced education.
Advance in agriculture is fundamental to a country's development.
Education is the basis of all aspects of development and growth.
Advances in health is possible due to fair public administration.
correctAnswer: Education is the basis of all aspects of development and growth.
explanation: The paragraph emphasizes education as the foundation for all development and growth.

text: Choose the word with correct spelling:
explanation: 'Maintenance' is the correctly spelled word among the options.

text: Which of the following is similar in meaning to glossy as used in paragraph 2? (From Reading Passage I)
explanation: In this context, 'glossy' refers to a smooth, shiny surface quality.

text: Why are 'voluntary vegetarians' mentioned in paragraph 5 in the passage? (From Reading Passage II)
options: to supplement the author's argument against the consequence of an increase in affluence.
to indicate that economic necessity is no longer significant in choosing what to eat.
to disprove the belief that there is an increase in the amount of animal protein eaten in the average diet.
to support the author's argument against animal protein in one's diet.
correctAnswer: to indicate that economic necessity is no longer significant in choosing what to eat.
explanation: Voluntary vegetarians choose their diet regardless of economic necessity.

text: Which sentence is closest to the head sentence: Both public and private authorities can manage transportation systems, which can involve maintaining and updating infrastructure to ensure the system runs smoothly.

text: What is the foundation of the hydro politics of the Nile River?

correctAnswer: The amount of water that the upper and lower stream countries are contributing to the Nile River.
explanation: Hydro politics of the Nile revolves around water contributions and usage rights between upstream and downstream countries. Ethiopia and other upstream countries contribute most of the water, while Egypt and Sudan have historically held usage rights based on colonial-era agreements.

text: The local ellipsoids reference used by Ethiopia is:
explanation: Ethiopia uses the World Geodetic System 1984 (WGS84) as its reference ellipsoid for mapping and geographic information systems. This is a global standard that provides a consistent coordinate system for the entire Earth.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: When an Ethiopian investor works temporarily in Sudan, his production is part of__________.
explanation: The production contributes to Sudanese GDP because it's produced within Sudan's borders, and to Ethiopian GNP (Gross National Product) because it's produced by an Ethiopian national. GNP includes income earned by a country's citizens and companies abroad.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which one of the following is the major cause of food insecurity in Ethiopia?
explanation: All listed factors contribute to food insecurity in Ethiopia.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which one of the following factors determines the distribution of natural vegetation in Ethiopia?
explanation: All listed factors influence the distribution of natural vegetation.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which one of the following is part of the Ethiopian Rift Valley?
explanation: Both the Afar Triangle and the Chew - Bahir rift are part of the Ethiopian Rift Valley.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which one is the oldest sedimentary rock formed in Ethiopia during the Triassic period of the Mesozoic era?
explanation: Addigrat sandstone is considered the oldest sedimentary rock formation in Ethiopia from the Triassic period of the Mesozoic era. It was formed approximately 250-200 million years ago and serves as the foundation for later sedimentary deposits.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: What is the general trend of rainfall distribution in Ethiopia?
options: Highest rainfall in the western highlands, decreasing towards the east
Highest rainfall in the eastern highlands, decreasing towards the west
Highest rainfall in the lowlands, decreasing towards the highlands
Uniform rainfall distribution throughout the country
correctAnswer: Highest rainfall in the western highlands, decreasing towards the east
explanation: Rainfall distribution in Ethiopia generally shows highest amounts in the western highlands.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which one of the following IS NOT true about the relative location of Ethiopia?
options: Ethiopia is surrounded by five neighboring countries
Ethiopia shares the longest length of boundary with Sudan
Ethiopia is located to the northwest of the Indian Ocean
Ethiopia is located to the southwest of the Asian continent
correctAnswer: Ethiopia is located to the southwest of the Asian continent
explanation: Ethiopia is located in the Horn of Africa, not southwest of the Asian continent.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: What makes Ethiopia the 'roof of East Africa'?
options: Its large proportion of arable land
explanation: Ethiopia is often referred to as the 'roof of East Africa' due to its highland areas.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Compared to the lowlands, the highlands of Ethiopia have:
explanation: Highlands typically have a denser human population due to favorable conditions.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which of the following is correct about the location of Ethiopia?
options: Ethiopia shares the longest border with Sudan
The northern point lies at 18 degrees north of the Equator
Ethiopia shares a longer border with Kenya than Eritrea
The southern border of Ethiopia lies about three degrees south of the Equator
correctAnswer: Ethiopia shares the longest border with Sudan
explanation: Ethiopia indeed shares the longest border with Sudan.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: What is a significant contemporary issue for both urban and rural livelihoods in Ethiopia?
explanation: Food scarcity is a pressing issue affecting livelihoods in Ethiopia.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which is an example of an institutional strategy for improving livelihood and food security in Ethiopia?
explanation: Government-led agricultural programs are institutional strategies for improving food security.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which historical event significantly influenced food security trends in Ethiopia?
explanation: The 1984 famine had a significant impact on food security in Ethiopia.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which of the following river basins of Ethiopia forms an inland drainage system?
options: The Baro and Akobo river basins
The Ghenale and Dawwa river basin
explanation: The Omo river basin forms an inland drainage system, as it flows into Lake Turkana (formerly Lake Rudolf) and does not reach the ocean. The Abay (Blue Nile) flows to the Mediterranean, while Baro-Akobo drains to the White Nile, and Genale-Dawa flows to the Indian Ocean.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: How do indigenous conflict resolution methods in Ethiopia differ from formal legal systems?
options: They prioritize win-win solutions over strict legal penalties
They focus on punishment rather than reconciliation
They exclude community elders from decision-making
They are uniformly applied across all ethnic groups.
correctAnswer: They prioritize win-win solutions over strict legal penalties
explanation: Indigenous methods often prioritize reconciliation and community involvement.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: If you travel from Ethiopia to Botswana in January, what type of climatic condition would you experience?
explanation: Botswana experiences summer rainfall in January during the southern hemisphere summer.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which type of soil is found in the desert and semi-desert areas of Ethiopia?
explanation: Yermosols are typical of desert and semi-desert regions.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which wild animal is unique to the Bale Mountains?
explanation: The Mountain Nyala is endemic to the Bale Mountains of Ethiopia, while the Walia Ibex is endemic to the Simien Mountains.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Why has the effectiveness of Ethiopia's Plan for Accelerated and Sustained Development to End Poverty (PASDEP) remained below the anticipated level? This is due to
explanation: Infrastructure limitations have hindered PASDEP's effectiveness.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which one of the following National Regional State of Ethiopia has the lowest percentage urban from the regional total population?
explanation: Afar region has the lowest urban population percentage in Ethiopia.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which one of the following describes the socioeconomic characteristics of Ethiopia?
options: More than a half of the rural population has access to electricity.
The illiteracy rate has been decreasing significantly since the 1990s.
Currently, Ethiopia is one of the middle income countries.
The majority of Ethiopian population has access to clean water.
correctAnswer: The illiteracy rate has been decreasing significantly since the 1990s.
explanation: Ethiopia has made significant progress in reducing illiteracy rates since the 1990s.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which of the following bounds the southern part of the Horn of Africa?
explanation: Kenya forms the southern boundary of the Horn of Africa.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: What is the advantage of compact shape of Ethiopia?
options: Easily direct access to the sea
explanation: Compact shape facilitates economic integration.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: One of the following demonstrates the strategic relative location of Ethiopia. Which one is it?
options: It is found in the lower Nile basin.
It is situated to the southeast of Asia.
It is one of the Middle East countries.
It is located in northeastern Africa.
correctAnswer: It is located in northeastern Africa.
explanation: Ethiopia's strategic location is in northeastern Africa.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which landform of the Horn serves as a watershed between the Awash and the Abbay River basins?
explanation: The Shewa Plateau divides the Awash and Abbay basins.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which of the following Ethiopian lakes is classified as the Rift Valley Lake?
explanation: Lake Abaya is part of the Rift Valley lake system.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Why is most of the farming activity practiced in the highland parts of Ethiopia?
options: The availability of large-scale irrigation schemes
The presence of vast areas of agricultural fields
Favorable topographic nature of the area
explanation: Reliable rainfall makes highlands more suitable for farming.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which one of the following best describes the major rivers of Ethiopia?
options: Most have no outlet to the sea.
correctAnswer: Most have no outlet to the sea.
explanation: Most Ethiopian rivers are endorheic (no outlet to the sea).

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which one of the following is considered as an economic impact of HIV/AIDS in Ethiopia?
explanation: Loss of skilled workers is a major economic impact of HIV/AIDS.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Currently, which one of the following wood is an important source of raw material for the furniture industries of Ethiopia?
explanation: Girar wood is widely used in Ethiopian furniture making.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
text: Which climatic zone of Ethiopia is the transition between the hot arid and the humid climates?
explanation: Woina-Dega is Ethiopia's transitional mid-altitude zone.

topicName: Geography of Ethiopia & Horn of Africa
